purpose: Frozen generic building-classification inputs; no dependency on any active resilience repository

details.provider: OpenStreetMap and Overture combined by the original extractor
details.snapshot_date: not independently recorded; no claim of current completeness

details.elevation_interpretation: metres relative to Hong Kong Principal Datum
details.warning: Point DTM samples are spatial evidence, not surveyed building base heights.

details.primary_provider: Hong Kong Lands Department / CSDI Building
details.height_definition: Original BaseHeight and TopHeight elevations retained; publisher height_m ignored and recomputed during validation
details.verification: Whole frozen file SHA256 matches distributor LFS object. Full ID/geometry/elevation comparisons performed; four example elevations checked independently against the official API. These are not independent height measurements.
details.source_observation_dates: not retained by distributor; retrieval date is not a survey date
details.primary_height_policy: structural component TopHeight minus BaseHeight; ground-to-top retained separately
details.integration_match_policy: Exact unique BuildingCSUID, compatible non-podium/podium type, valid source geometry and footprint IoU >=0.95; retain local footprints

details.input_local_modified_date: 2026-04-20; extraction observation dates not independently guaranteed
details.warning: Explicit infrastructure tags and comparable unique polygon footprints are required; no point equipment tags are donated to their host buildings.

limitations: Point terrain evidence is not a surveyed building base
Raw converted LandsD BASEHEIGHT values are all null
Source height and footprint/base conventions can differ; conflicts remain unknown
Other source input hashes are recorded by the reproduction runner
CSDI supplement is a frozen public distribution of official source fields, not a direct full API download; distributor height_m is unused
Primary v2 height is component top minus base; point-terrain and OSM heights remain separate
Source survey dates are not retained in the public distribution; stable component ID/type/geometry gates limit but do not eliminate time mismatch
